key_concepts: The universe is everything that exists, including all matter, energy, space, and time.
A galaxy is a vast collection of stars and planetary systems.
The Milky Way Galaxy contains billions of stars, including the Sun.
The solar system is a planetary system within the Milky Way Galaxy centered on the Sun.
The Sun is the star at the center of the solar system that provides light and heat.
Planets are large, round celestial bodies that orbit the Sun.
Moons are natural celestial bodies that orbit planets.
Comets are icy bodies made of ice, dust, and rock that orbit the Sun.
Asteroids are rocky space rocks of varying shapes and sizes that orbit the Sun.
Meteoroids are debris from asteroids or comets, meteors are light trails of burning meteor
Dwarf planets orbit the Sun and are round but have not cleared their orbital neighborhood.
